title: The Duck Bread Baker
description: Join Duck on his delicious journey as he sets out to satisfy his love for bread. But when all his feathered friends fall ill, he learns that a diet of just bread isn’t the way to go.
author: David Fairbairn

cover.alt: The Duck Bread Baker cover, showing a yellow duck surrounded by loaves of bread.

illustrations.alt: Three yellow ducks swim below a footbridge while a person walks overhead.
A yellow duck looks down sadly after realising he has made a mistake.
Green leaves frame the page around the book’s nutrition facts.
